response.sql: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow, AVG(oe.fillcount) as group_avg_fillcount FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault WHERE oe.expirespot BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow) SELECT AVG(group_avg_fillcount) as overall_average FROM group_averages;

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in fillcount are automatically ignored by AVG() per standard SQL semantics
Text-based BETWEEN comparison on ISO-formatted timestamps (lexicographic ordering) is suitable for the date range filter
